beckonsnare.name: Beckonsnare
beckonsnare.description: Field-and-forget, the Beckonsnare emits an ultrasonic frequency enticing to targeted lifeforms. Upon entering they are comfortably contained within a one-way photon fence for easy collection at your convenience.

beryl-antitoxin.name: Beryl Antitoxin
beryl-antitoxin.description: This is a mildly effective antitoxin.

beta-corruptor.name: Beta Corruptor
beta-corruptor.description: Inert on its own this corruptor is highly effective if mixed with its Alpha counterpart. Properly mixed, these will destabilize Fomorian Reactors much faster than their Stable counterparts. This volatile item cannot be simultaneously equipped with Alpha Corruptors. Recommended for Tenno operating as a team.

bleeding-dragon-key.name: Bleeding Dragon Key
bleeding-dragon-key.description:
Health is greatly reduced while key is equipped.

Blueprint can be obtained via the Orokin Lab in a Clan Dojo.

bolarola-echo-lure.name: Bolarola Echo-Lure
bolarola-echo-lure.description: Entice and attract nearby Bolarola with life-like animal calls. The Bolarola is most often found around the Mountainous areas of Orb Vallis.

bolarola-pheromone-synthesizer.name: Bolarola Pheromone Synthesizer
bolarola-pheromone-synthesizer.description: Deploy just before using the echo-lure to increase the chance of attracting a rarer subspecies of Bolarola.

broad-spectrum-bait.name: Broad-Spectrum Bait
broad-spectrum-bait.description:
A simple cocktail of short-chain polymers and contaminants. Easily detected by rudimentary Servofish in the Orb Vallis under all conditions, but ignored by more specialized models. Good for Sapcaddies (found in the lake), and Tinks and Brickies (found in ponds).

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
